body: Right now Earth OGW drag input comes from precomputed HDF5 artifacts that bake in resolution and parameters. This adds `raw_topo_online` (reusing the same machinery) so it's computed on the fly at init from ETOPO + ClimaParams (γ, h_frac, α_smoothing). Keeps raw_topo as-is for the fast/reproducible path, with a warning when params don't match the artifact. Replaces hard-coded alpha smoothing parameter with `ogw_smoothing_scale_fraction`, which is now in ClimaParams.
title: Add on-the-fly orographic gravity wave drag preprocessing

body: Adds some microphysics parameters to the default that produce somewhat reasonable cloud radiative effects and profiles relative to other RCEMIPII models. These were taken from an EKI calibration I've been performing, but they are not the fully calibrated parameters (yet!)
title: Update RCE default microphysics parameters
